oracle.sql:
WITH m AS (SELECT id FROM entities WHERE entity_type='customer' AND merged_into IS NULL AND data->>'service_address' ILIKE $1)
SELECT e.data->>'manufacturer' AS v FROM entities e
WHERE e.entity_type='equipment' AND e.merged_into IS NULL AND e.customer_id IN (SELECT id FROM m)
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM m) = 1 AND coalesce(e.data->>'manufacturer', '') <> ''
